neighbours.label: The token ' app' as a word in ordinary prose, against other nouns in the same slot.
fire: My sister built a small app for her class.
That app crashed on my phone twice.
You can pay with the app at the counter.
We tried a music app during the trip.
Each app needs its own password.
Install the app before you travel.
Her banking app stopped working last night.
The weather app said it would rain.
quiet: My sister built a small model for her class.
That game crashed on my phone twice.
You can pay with the card at the counter.
We tried a music class during the trip.
Each door needs its own key.
Install the software before you travel.
Her banking card stopped working last night.
The weather report said it would rain.

notes: The pole's max is tiny (0.25) and it is flagged broad, so fractions are noisy. '(matrix' and '(msg' read higher than ' app' in probes and are not covered by this label.
